meta.description: Structural material constants, Phase 1: structural steel per EN 10025.
meta.units: Moduli and strengths in kN/m2 (matches Karamba's IsotropicMaterial inputs directly: E=210000000 means 210 GPa); density in kg/m3; thickness bounds in mm
meta.note: fy is thickness-dependent; rows give the t<=40mm nominal value with the 40<t<=80mm value alongside. gammaM0/gammaM1 are EC3 recommended values (national annexes may differ).
